description: 6 should-trigger + 6 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers the six lanes that produce hand-authored SVG — a glyph the incumbent set lacks, a simple geometric mark, an animated asset, a surgical edit to an existing file, an SVG diagram, and a raster converted to a vector. Should-not-trigger covers the near-miss neighbours this skill sits between: an icon the set already has (iconography), a full brand pipeline (logo-generation), a raster image (image-generation), provider choice (image-provider-routing), video motion (motion-choreographer), and reduced-motion policy (fe-design).

queries.q: draw an SVG icon the set does not have — a 'split branch' glyph matching our Lucide stroke
author a simple geometric mark as SVG — two overlapping circles, brand blue, no text
animate this logo SVG so the ring draws on over 800ms
change only the hat in this SVG and leave everything else byte-identical
turn the logo in this PNG into a real vector without the app name
hand-place an SVG architecture diagram — five boxes and typed edges
which Heroicons name is the download action?
queries.note: the set already has it → iconography

queries.q: generate a logo for my bakery called Golden Crust
generate a photoreal hero image of a coffee shop at dawn
which provider should I use for complex illustrative vector art?
choreograph the camera move and the cut timing for this product video
what is our policy on prefers-reduced-motion durations across the app?
queries.note: motion policy → fe-design § Motion; this skill points at it and never restates it
